subject.title: feat: add two-way voice turns to Apple Watch chat

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Apple Watch two-way voice turns now, and should the accepted shape be turn-scoped Watch speech rather than iPhone Talk mode or global message speech?
rationale: This is a new user-facing companion-app mode on a protected maintainer-labeled issue; source inspection shows it is missing, but automation should not choose the permanent Watch UX and release priority.

options.title: Sponsor turn-scoped Watch voice turns
options.body: Implement the issue as a Watch-specific action that speaks only the assistant reply produced by that turn and keeps ordinary text/dictation messages silent.

options.title: Defer Watch voice turns
options.body: Keep the text chat surface as-is until watchOS companion surfaces graduate or a broader voice roadmap prioritizes Watch audio.

options.title: Fold into broader voice/Talk work
options.body: Reframe this as part of a cross-device Talk design, accepting a larger product/API discussion before implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor turn-scoped Watch voice turns
recommendation.body: Implement the issue as a Watch-specific action that speaks only the assistant reply produced by that turn and keeps ordinary text/dictation messages silent.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Watch action surface that this feature would extend and provided the strongest existing Watch chat delivery proof.
